record.headline: Asana’s pay-as-you-go AI billing now lists a $5.99 per user, per month seat charge, billed annually, in addition to $0.60 per AI request.
rows: On-demand seat charge, per user per month
record.who: Teams on Starter, Advanced, Enterprise and Enterprise+ that use on-demand billing for AI requests instead of prepaid packs.
record.read: A per-seat fee on top of per-request pricing turns the on-demand option into a hybrid meter. It may nudge teams toward prepaid packs at $0.50 per request.
record.caveat: The page showed two versions in one run; they differ in the AI Meetings and Tables feature rollout, while the $5.99 line appears in both. The page does not say whether the charge applies to existing customers or is only newly disclosed.
